description: Source code for expression command classes in calculator engine, including command handling for parentheses, unary, binary, and operand commands.

classes.name: CParentheses
classes.description: Represents parentheses commands in calculator expressions.

classes.name: COpndCommand
classes.description: Represents operand commands, including number tokens and formatting.

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Returns the command code for parentheses.

methods.name: GetCommandType
methods.description: Returns the command type enum for the command.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for serialization or processing.

methods.name: SetCommand
methods.description: Sets the command code for unary and binary commands.

methods.name: GetCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of command codes for operand commands.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes operand command with a rational value.

methods.name: AppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command code to operand command, handling scientific notation.

methods.name: ToggleSign
methods.description: Toggles the sign of the operand.

methods.name: RemoveFromEnd
methods.description: Removes the last command from operand command.

methods.name: IsNegative
methods.description: Returns whether the operand is negative.

methods.name: IsSciFmt
methods.description: Returns whether operand is in scientific format.

methods.name: IsDecimalPresent
methods.description: Checks if decimal point is present in operand.

methods.name: ClearAllAndAppendCommand
methods.description: Clears current commands and appends a new command, resetting flags.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Generates string token representation of operand.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the operand's value.
